STATEMENT: For any list `l` of natural numbers, the length of the list after filtering out elements greater than or equal to 5 is less than or equal to the length of the original list.

  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs =>
    have h1 : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x < 5) xs) ≤ List.length xs := by
      apply final_dev_0034
